units: feet above MLLW (NAVD88 + 0.19 ft, NOAA La Jolla datums)

columns.danger_bay_ft: lowest still-water level at which water from Mission Bay reaches it
columns.danger_bay_berm_ft: same, if Mission Beach's bay-side sand berm holds (see flood_threshold.py)
columns.danger_ocean_ft: same, from the open ocean (waves not included)
columns.covered_bay_ft / covered_ocean_ft: streets only: level at which the middle of the road is under water along at least half of the 25 m stretch
columns.ground_min_ft: lowest ground nearby (below the water but above danger height = storm-drain risk)
